name: v7 / P3: conformal prediction intervals around core-corrected GHIST+ predictions
prior_art: TISSUE (Sun et al., Nat Methods 2024) calibrates uncertainty for spatial imputation; this is an adaptation to the H&E core-to-WSI setting, not a new uncertainty method

settings.tumour_biased: 4 x 1 mm2 tumour-biased cores as in config_v5.json (stress test)

methods_wrapped.GHIST+: export; residuals on core cells (no fitting)
methods_wrapped.GHIST+-Soft: q * relu(mu); residuals on core cells (no fitting)
methods_wrapped.RRC-authors: leave-one-core-out out-of-fold residuals with its chosen alpha/blend
methods_wrapped.HAC: leave-one-core-out out-of-fold residuals at the chosen alpha
methods_wrapped.HAC-mondrian: HAC with radii per gene x GHIST+-predicted cell type (9 classes); classes with < 50 core cells fall back to the per-gene radius

interval: [max(0, y_hat - r), y_hat + r]; r = per-gene empirical quantile of |y - y_hat_oof| over core cells at level min(1, ceil((n+1)*0.9)/n)
metrics: on evaluation cells: coverage (median over genes) for all entries and for expressing entries (y > 0); mean interval width; coverage for tumour-type vs other cells; coverage for out-of-support cells (P2 support rule)

amendment_1.date: 2026-11-09, after one Breast5K smoke run (unbiased, seed 0), before any full P3 run or ATERA computation
amendment_1.reason: Per-gene marginal intervals are degenerate on zero-inflated data. Smoke run: HAC coverage 0.92 with width 0.11, but coverage of expressing entries 0.000, because the 90% residual quantile is set by the zeros.

added_primary.occurrence_calibration: reliability of the predicted P(expressed) against 1[y > 0] on evaluation cells: expected calibration error (10 equal-width bins, pooled over cells x genes) and median per-gene Brier score, for raw GHIST+ q, intercept-recalibrated q + c, and HAC's q_hat
added_primary.conditional_magnitude_interval: per gene, radius = conformal quantile (90%) of |y - m_hat| over expressing core cells (genes with >= 20); interval [max(0, m_hat - r), m_hat + r]; coverage and width on expressing evaluation entries. Baseline: the same with uncalibrated relu(mu)

amendment_1.decision_rule_added: Hurdle-aware uncertainty is useful if, in the unbiased setting on both slides, HAC's q_hat has lower ECE and lower median Brier than raw GHIST+ q, and the conditional magnitude interval reaches coverage in [0.85, 0.95] on expressing evaluation entries. The original marginal rule below is still evaluated and reported.

decision_rule: P3 delivers calibrated intervals if, in the unbiased setting on both slides, HAC or HAC-mondrian reaches median all-entry coverage in [0.87, 0.93] with a mean width smaller than the same procedure applied to the GHIST+ export and to RRC-authors. Expressing-entry coverage and the biased-core coverage drop are reported as limitations, whatever they show.
